channel.title: Bargain Hunt
channel.desc: Christina Trevanion heads to Shrewsbury in Shropshire, where experts Philip Serrell and Izzie Balmer guide the red and blue teams as they go in search of some bargains to sell at auction in Lichfield. Christina takes a ride on the Bridgnorth Cliff Railway, one of England's oldest and steepest funicular railways.
